v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me. ‡
text.en: Lord, * thou hast proved me, and known me. ‡

text.la: Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
text.en: Wonderful are thy works * and my soul knoweth right well.

text.la: Ne derelínquas me, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
text.en: Do not thou forsake me, * O Lord, the strength of my salvation.

text.la: Dómine, * clamávi ad te, exáudi me. ‡
text.en: I have cried to thee, * O Lord, hear me. ‡

text.la: Educ de custódia * ánimam meam, Dómine, ad confiténdum nómini tuo.
text.en: Bring my soul * out of prison, O Lord, that I may praise thy name.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui invéntus est sine mácula, et qui post aurum non ábiit, nec sperávit in pecúnia et thesáuris. Quis est hic, et laudábimus eum? fecit enim mirabília in vita sua.
text.en: Blessed is the rich man that is found without blemish: and that hath not gone after gold, nor put his trust in money nor in treasures. Who is he, and we will praise him? for he hath done wonderful things in his life.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte Bernárde, divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei.
text.en: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, Bernard, blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God.

text.la: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Bernárdum minístrum tribuísti: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, quem Doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris, intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis.
text.en: O God, who didst give blessed Bernard to be thy people’s minister in eternal salvation; grant, we pray, that we who have him for teacher of life here on earth, may also deserve now that he is in heaven, to have him for an advocate.

office.title: S. Bernardi Abbatis et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
